name: 艾莉丝 狂剑王
author: DSH Skin Workshop
tagline: 无职转生的红发狂剑王、淡绯金魔法阵与侧栏幼年立牌
taglineEn: A pale crimson Sword King, arcane sigils and a young Eris standee
description: 以《无职转生》艾莉丝·伯雷亚斯·格雷拉特为主题的淡色皮肤：对话区铺魔法大陆场景与两幅立绘，左侧任务栏立一块幼年艾莉丝立牌，并以淡绯金配色、魔法阵纹章和鎏金描边重新装饰侧栏。
descriptionEn: A pale Mushoku Tensei skin built around Eris Boreas Greyrat: a soft magic-continent scene with two full-body figures behind the conversation, a young Eris standee in the sidebar, and a rose-and-gold retheme of the sidebar chrome.
